Deep in the Fibula dungeon, beyond a level 50 door, there is a cave full of minotaurs and dragons. At the end of the cave, scattered among the corpses of humans, skeletons and dragons, are five treasures: {item:Knight Axe}, {item:Warrior Helmet}, {item:Elven Amulet}, {item:Tower Shield} and {item:Dwarven Ring}.
Level 50 to pass the level gate (gate of expertise); 60+ recommended.

The final part has about 16 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and 4 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}: bring enough supplies or go as a team.
Some corpses have to be opened manually: depending on the controls you use, Tibia may try to {wiki:Quick Looting|Quick Loot} instead of opening the corpse.
1. Going down into the Fibula dungeon

Go to **Fibula**, a small island **southwest** of Thais: from Thais cross the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} (or use the teleport on the second floor of the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}). In the village of Fibula, enter the {wiki:Fibula Dungeon|dungeon} through the well. Follow the path on the map. If you find a locked door, open it with the {item:Key 3940} (bought on the island).
After going down, head **east** and go through a teleport.

You end up in front of two teleports. Pass the **level 50 gate** (gate of expertise) and enter the **right-hand** teleport. You arrive in a room with 2 {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards} and 4 {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}.
Deeper Fibula Quest map (the Key 3980 hole and the treasures are marked)
Cross the fields to the west
Keep going **west** across {item:Fire Field|fire} and {item:Energy Field|energy} fields.
At the hole to the **west** (marked on the map), "use" it to get the {item:Key 3980}.
Head south and open the door
Go back and head **south**, killing a few {wiki:Minotaurs|minotaurs} (normal ones and archers if you go east; normal ones and mages if you go west). Open the door with the {item:Key 3980}.
In the next room there are lots of minotaurs of every kind.
Keep going straight. Now you face about **16 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}** and **4 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}** (one at the cave entrance and three at the exit).
Dragon Lords cast Fire Bomb and breathe fire. Don't pull several dragons at once.
The rewards are in corpses of humans, skeletons and dragons scattered at the end of the cave. Use the map above.

In the **northwest** corner of the cave, under a {item:Fire Field}, inside a skeleton. Use a {item:Destroy Field Rune} on the fire. If you don't have one, lure a {creature:Dragon Lord} to cast {wiki:Fire Bomb|Fire Bomb} on you/over the fire field and wait about 7 minutes and 26 seconds for the fire to disappear.
**South** of the Tower Shield, in a skeleton hidden behind a rock.
**North** of the exit portal, inside a skeleton.
Just **east** of the Dwarven Ring, in a dragon corpse out in the open.
**Southeast** of the Elven Amulet, in a human corpse.

The portal in the **southwest** part of the last room takes you back to the dungeon entrance. From there go up the well to the village of Fibula and return to Thais through the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel}, to the **northeast**.
You can get the Tower Shield and the Knight Axe without Destroy Field: lure the Dragon Lord so that it casts a Fire Bomb over the existing fire field; the fire disappears after a few minutes.
